title: docs(pm): the ui lane names the objectui label/assignee write channel
body:
Fixes #18120

Under lock 1 an objectui session cannot write a label or an assignee through MCP `issue_write` (its `.claude/settings.json` on `origin/main` denies the tool), and nothing an objectui seat reads said what to use instead: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md` carried no `label` line at all. The channel already exists and already takes the repository — the objectstack checkout's `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --repo owner/name`, with the four steps and the read-back built in — so this card is one rule line in the lane register, not a mechanism.

## The rule line — `lanes/ui.md` :23, 118 bytes (cap 120)

```text
- 本仓标签/assignee 写走 objectstack `label-write.mjs --repo`,⛔ 不 MCP `issue_write`;被拒转有通道席。
```

It sits next to :22 「`scripts/pm/**` 单写手恒在 objectstack 侧 ⇒ 本席的工具需求走上游卡带 `Blocked-by:` 回链。」 — the channel is that objectstack-side single writer. It deliberately does not restate `references/rest-channel.md` :38–:39, which already carry the four steps, the read-back and the prohibition for objectstack cards:

```text
- 标签/assignee 写恒经 `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`:四步内建、回读、回退整组 PATCH 回传 assignees。
- ⛔ 永不 MCP `issue_write`(锁 1 已拒);会话分类器拒改动 ⇒ 无通道,交有通道席位立卡。
```

What is new here is the cross-repository half — `--repo` — plus the hand-off when a session's classifier refuses the write.

## Line budget — net 0, paid by a deletion, not by a re-wrap

`lanes/ui.md` is pinned at 38 lines with zero headroom (`check:pm-skill-ratchet`). Payment is the deletion of :15 「症状位置不改流向,docs 随所记录的面走,两条同上节,⛔ 不在此另抄。」 — a pointer-only line that says as much itself.

**Where the deleted rule survives:** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` :198, inside 〈多仓协调〉 (heading at :185) — 「其余(发布库与 apps)归 `domain:ui` 执行席;症状位置不改流向,docs 随所记录的面走。」 The lane file already points at that section from :3 and from :13, so the rule stays reachable for the seat that reads the lane. No ceiling raised, no line re-wrapped, no other file touched.

## Acceptance — both directions, measured on `bb9e97d3f`

- `git grep -c label-write -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md` → **1** (0 before the edit); the literal control 「单写手」 still hits, now at :22.
- `wc -l` → **38** lines, unchanged; the ratchet prints `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md is 38 lines (ceiling 38; headroom 0).`
- `LC_ALL=C awk 'length($0)>120'` over the file prints nothing; the new line measures 118 bytes.
- `git diff --name-only a90a9f267..HEAD` prints exactly one path — so `references/rest-channel.md` is untouched, and no `permissions.allow` text is added anywhere.
- objectui `AGENTS.md` is untouched by construction: that file lives in the sibling repository and is not in this diff's repo at all.
- `grep -naP` control-byte self-scan over the edited file: no hits (`check:nul-bytes` green over 8,652 files).

## Gates — derived, run in the foreground, reconciled

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 15 families from the working-tree change set; all 15 ran with the exit code captured before any pipe, and all exited 0:

```text
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 15 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 15 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED
  (a DERIVED zero — all 15 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).
```

Named in the dispatch and green here: `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (27 files clean), `check:nul-bytes`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, plus `check:pm-governed-prose` (not in the derived set — it scores `silent` as an artifact roster — run anyway: 2 instruction surfaces name all 5 registered governed surfaces).

Six of the fifteen first exited **3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET** on a fresh worktree (`node_modules` absent; one also needed `@objectstack/formula` + `@objectstack/lint` built). That is not a verdict: `pnpm install`, then the build under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (`VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 2s · waited 0s`), then a re-run — all 0.

## Changeset

`skip-changeset` label, applied through the additive endpoint and read back. `.claude/**` publishes nothing: no package `files[]` ships it, and the fast-track list names `.claude/**` directly.

## Deviation from the dispatch's suggested route

The suggested wording measured **171 bytes** against the 120-byte cap, so it could not land as written; the shipped line is a compressed spelling of the same three clauses (channel + `--repo`, ⛔ MCP `issue_write`, hand-off on refusal). The suggested payment (dropping :15) measured correct and is what was used.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — objectui 车道岗位说明加一行:objectui 卡的标签/assignee 写,走 objectstack 检出里的 `label-write.mjs --repo`,不走 MCP;会话被拒就把卡交给有通道的席位。同一文件删掉一行纯指针句(它的两条规则逐字住在 SKILL.md 〈多仓协调〉:198),行数 38 不变。

**为什么改** — 锁 1 已在两仓落地,objectui 会话的 MCP 写标签能力被拒。通道是有的(objectstack 侧那一个脚本,已在 objectui 卡上实跑过),但 objectui 席位读的文件没有一处写着它。席位找不到通道时会把状态记在散文里,而不是记在标签上——这正是同一失败形态在第二个仓的复发。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 风险低:纯指令面一行,无代码、无发布物。代价是删掉的那行指针句;它的规则在 SKILL.md 仍在,车道文件 :3 与 :13 都指向该节。回滚 = revert 本 PR 一次提交,文件回到 38 行原样。

**席位意见** — (待席位定稿)

**你要做的** — 读一下新增那行的措辞是否符合你的口径(尤其「被拒转有通道席」这半句),然后人工合并:本 PR 触 `.claude/**`,属受管面,只能由你手工落地。另:objectui 会话真正键入的那条命令要不要进 `permissions.allow`(前缀拼写在 objectui 会话里不一样),仍等你的裁决,本卡按 out of scope 处理。
